title: Updates on VAT appeals
text:
This is a list of VAT appeals that HMRC has lost, or partly lost, that could have implications for other businesses.

 The list is updated regularly and details of finalised cases are retained for 6 months.
changeNote: The list of VAT appeals that HMRC has lost and that may have implications for other businesses has been updated with 3 additions, 5 amendments and 3 removals.
